analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (109,380 KRW) vs SMA5 (106,342 KRW) / SMA20 (107,574 KRW) / SMA50 (106,158 KRW): Confirms short-to-mid-term uptrend.
· Position vs SMA100 (115,916 KRW) / SMA200 (95,339 KRW): Mixed mid-to-long-term trend, maintaining strength above SMA200.
· 52-week position (59.3%) + Current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (52.1→52.8): Staying in neutral zone, confirming gradual upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (754.2302→37.0044): Continuous improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid Band 107,574 KRW): Trading near the mid-band, bandwidth at 9.27% is normal.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (100,000 KRW): Based on Pivot S1 (101,500 KRW) and 20-day low (100,000 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (110,910 KRW): Breakthrough could lead to further upside.
· 5-day / 20-day High/Low Pattern: Forming a Higher Low pattern, strengthening recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.55x): Low volume suggests potential weakening of upward momentum.
· Current phase diagnosis: Pullback within an uptrend, meeting buy entry conditions.
